title: Phase 83 adds community-institution, social-infrastructure, and collective-resilience controls
summary: Eight inactive community-institution dossiers, eight inactive civic-network and mutual-aid ledgers, eight inactive local-information integrity registers, and eight inactive collective-resilience ledgers now expose the community-capacity contract. Twelve guides and six maps deepen the content without admitting, activating, suppressing, closing, restoring, scoring, ranking, or deciding for a community.
evidence_note: This release contains empty community-institution, civic-network, mutual-aid, volunteer, local-media, public-knowledge, information-integrity, preparedness, collective-trauma, closure, restoration, recovery, and remedy contracts plus synthetic-only validation. It does not contain a verified Phase 82 household-security record or a Phase 83 decision or receipt.
publication_effect: Adds twelve Published briefings, six Published maps, one searchable registry with thirty-two detail routes, one public export, and reader-surface integrations while leaving all evidence, household, institution, civic, information, emergency, and operating states unchanged.
